Change in estimates of prior year provisions 96,953 (46,949) 50,004

During the current period, the Syndicate entered into a transaction to reinsure certain prior year claims liabilities. The transaction had a positive net impact on the reported profit for the financial year.

prior_year_events.event_name: Transaction to reinsure certain prior year claims liabilities
prior_year_events.impact_description: Syndicate entered into a transaction to reinsure certain prior year claims liabilities; had a positive net impact on reported profit (reinsurance recoveries impacted net result).

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's gross claims outstanding opened at GBP 3,154.5m. During 2024 there was an adverse prior-year reestimation (strengthening) of gross prior-year reserves of GBP 96.953m (3.07% of opening gross reserves), as shown in the technical provisions reconciliation. Management also entered into a reinsurance transaction in the period to reinsure certain prior-year claims liabilities which had a positive net impact on reported profit; the gross strengthening remained material. The movement is therefore reported as a portfolio-level prior-year strengthening, with reinsurance recoveries and claims inflation among the drivers noted in the report.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) taken from Note 12 technical provisions row 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' (gross column). No explicit per-line gross PYD breakdown provided. Claims development triangle formatting in the PDF/extracted text is irregular (some rows contain summary/aggregate totals that may shift column alignment); the triangle was parsed as presented but formatting oddities (very large values appearing in some rows) suggest caution.
